sloka: पंच पंच नखा भक्ष्या ब्रह्म क्षत्रेण राघव ।शल्यकः श्वाविधो गोधा शशः कूर्मः च पंचमः ॥४-१७-३९॥
transliteration: paṁca paṁca nakhā bhakṣyā brahma kṣatreṇa rāghava ।śalyakaḥ śvāvidho godhā śaśaḥ kūrmaḥ ca paṁcamaḥ ॥4-17-39॥

translations.english: 'O king the learned do not even touch my skin or bone. They do not eat my flesh. While it is so, you have unnecessarily killed me, a fivenailed animal.
